caption: The video captures a frothy bright-green liquid being poured into a speckled gray ceramic cup. In the first view, a sweater-clad hand tilts a clear glass vessel, and the liquid falls in a steady stream toward the cup against blurred green foliage. The pouring is already underway, and the glass remains partly filled with the vibrant mixture. A cut shifts the scene to a close top-down angle of the same cup resting on a plain gray surface. From this viewpoint, the falling column of green liquid, the cup interior, and the speckled rim fill the frame, while the source vessel stays mostly out of view. The stream lands near the center at first, then drifts toward the left inner wall. The pool inside the cup grows and rises, its surface covered with fine foam and scattered bubbles. The cup remains stationary throughout the second view, and the pouring continues without a visible end.
